# Water Capital Wire

> A free daily read on the business of water for managers, investors and operators: capital, companies, technology, infrastructure and water security, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a lead story traced through the water cycle (source, treatment, use, reuse, discharge), briefs across the water economy, weekly spotlights on a company, a leader, a supplier, an innovation and an investor, a capital desk of deals and firms, a water atlas on stress, demand, infrastructure, emerging sectors and security, a watchlist of water equities, a project calculator and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Nevada's planned data centers could use 4 billion gallons a year to cool, and power plants nearly twice that](https://watercapitalwire.com/): November 23, 2026. A new Desert Research Institute study finds 39 proposed Nevada data centers could use about 4 billion gallons a year for cooling by 2036, while the power plants serving them would consume nearly twice as much water again.
- [Capital: Diamondback and KKR buy out Five Point to own all of the Deep Blue water network](https://watercapitalwire.com/#money)
- [Security: Fiji declares a nationwide state of disaster as El Niño drought reaches crisis level](https://watercapitalwire.com/#world)
- [Desalination: Saudi Water Authority cancels Wabag's $272 million Yanbu desalination award, again](https://watercapitalwire.com/#desal)
- [Capital: Air Water Ventures agrees to buy Proud Source Water for up to $150 million](https://watercapitalwire.com/#bottled)
